Title: Kite Kubernetes proxy path traversal allows authenticated users to bypass RBAC and read cluster-wide resources
Description: Kite versions 0.6.9 through 0.14.0 authorize Kubernetes proxy requests against the pod or service identified by the original route parameters. Encoded path traversal segments can cause the upstream URL to resolve to a different Kubernetes API endpoint after authorization.
NotImpacted: All versions before 0.6.9, all versions starting from 0.14.1
